description: This file defines the LoggerMDC class, which manages mapped diagnostic context (MDC) data for logging in a PHP project. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, and removing context entries, and references external log4php components.

classes.name: LoggerMDC
classes.description: Provides static methods to manage per-thread mapped diagnostic context data, allowing insertion, retrieval, and removal of context-specific key-value pairs for logging.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the current thread's MDC, respecting a maximum size limit.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in the MDC, including special handling for server and environment variables.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value from the MDC.
